entries.def:
καθ-άπτω 
[in Sm.: Sng.1.6 * ;] 
__1. to fasten on, put upon, with accusative 
__2. Act. for mid. (cf. Bl., § 53, 3), to lay hold of, attack: with genitive, χειρός, Act.28.3.†
(AS)

καθαρίζω
(Hellenistic-FlJ, Inscr.-for Attic καθαίρω, which see, on the vulgar -ερ-, Mat.8.3, Mrk.1.42, see Bl., § 6, 1; Thackeray, Gr., 74) [in LXX chiefly for טָהֵר ;] 
to cleanse, make clean. 
__1. In physical sense: with accusative of thing(s), figuratively, Mat.23.25-26, Luk.11.39; of disease (leprosy), with accusative of person(s), Mat.8.2-3; 10.8; 11.5, Mrk.1.40-42 Luk.4.27; 5.12-13; 7.22; 17.14, 17; ἡ λέπρα…

καθαρισμός, -oῦ, τό
(καθαρίζω). [in LXX for טָהֵר, טׇהֳרָה, etc. ;] 
cleansing, purification: Jhn.3.25 with genitive subjc., τ. Ἰουδαίων, Jhn.2.6 with genitive obj., of women after childbirth, Luk.2.22 of lepers, Mrk.1.44, Luk.5.14; with genitive of thing(s), τ. ἁμαρτιῶν, Heb.1.3, 2Pe.1.9 (Cremer, 319).†
(AS)

καθαρός, -ά, -όν 
[in LXX chiefly for טָהוֹר ;] 
pure, clean. 
__1. Physically: Mat.23.26; 27.59, Jhn.13.10-11 (fig.), Jhn.15.3 (figuratively, as of a vine cleansed by pruning), Heb.10.22, Rev.15.6; 19.8, 14; 21.18, 21. 
__2. Ceremonially: Luk.11.41, Rom.14.20, Tit.1.15. 
__3. Ethically; 
__(a) of persons: Jhn.13.16, Act.18.6, Tit.1.15; ό κ. τῇ καρδίᾳ (καθαρὸς χεῖρας, Hdt., i, 35), Mat.5.8 before ἀπό (cl. with…

καθαρότης, -ητος, ἡ
(καθαρός), [in LXX: Exo.24.10 (טֹהַר), Wis.7.24 * ;] 
purity, cleanness: with genitive, Heb.9.13.†
(AS)

καθ-έδρα, -ας, ἡ
(κατά, + ἔδρα, a seat) [in LXX for מוֹשָׁב and cogn. forms ;] 
a chair, seat: Mat.21.12, Mrk.11.16; of teachers, Mat.23.2.†
(AS)

καθ-έζομαι 
[in LXX: Lev.12.5, al. (יָשַׁב), Job.39.28 (שָׁכַן) ;] 
to sit down, sit: Jhn.20.12 before ἐν, Mat.26.55, Luk.2.46, Jhn.11.20, Act.6.15; before ἐπί, with genitive, Act.20.9 id. with dative, Jhn.4.6 (cf. παρα-καθέζ-, κάθημαι).†
καθ ̓ εἷς, see: (εἷς.)
(AS)

καθ-εξῆς
(= cl. ἑξῆς, ἐφεξῆς) 
adv., 
__1. successively, in order: Luk.1.3, Act.11.4; 18.23; τῶν κ.. (those that succeeded him), Act.3.24. 
__2. after­wards: ἐν τῷ κ. (sc. χρόνῳ), Luk.8.1.†
(AS)

καθεύδω 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַב, Gen.28.13, Psa.88.5, al.; also for יָשֵׁן, Sng.5.2, Dan LXX TH Dan.12.2, al.; for יָשַׁב, 1Sa.19.9 ;] 
to sleep: Mat.8.24; 9.24; 13.25; 25.5; 26.46, 43; 26.45, Mrk.4.27, 38; 5.39; 14.37, 40-41, Luk.8.52; 22.46, 1Th.5.7. Metaphorical, 
__(a) of death (as Ps, Da, ll. with): 1Th.5.10 (cf. Mat.9.24, Mrk.5.39, Luk.8.52, and see Swete, Mk., l.with); 
__(b) of moral and spiritual…

καθηγητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(καθηγέομαι, to go before, guide), 
__1. prop., a guide. 
__2. a master, teacher (MGr. professor): Mat.23.16.†
(AS)
